CURRENT ACTUAL POLICY (authoritative; overrides the manual where they differ):
[card transactions] Overseas jewelry merchants: DENY (corridor_blocked). Other categories have no region restriction.
[card transactions] Same-day approved total plus this charge above $2000.00: ESCALATE (daily_cap).
[card transactions] Instant-approve limits: electronics $650.00, travel $900.00; above the limit ESCALATE (over_limit).
[limit increases] Accounts with a recent chargeback: DENY (account_standing), whatever the amount.
[limit increases] Approvable cap: $4200.00; above the cap DENY (cap_exceeded).
[transfers] Payees added fewer than 30 days ago require review only above $6500.00: ESCALATE (new_payee_review).
[transfers] Otherwise, the reporting threshold is $8000.00; above it ESCALATE (reportable_amount).
Anything not restricted above: APPROVE. When two rules apply, the first matching line above wins.
[ranked alternatives] Carry out the FIRST listed alternative that the lines above APPROVE; alternatives that would be denied or escalated are skipped. If none can be approved, the case takes leg 1's own disposition, citing the code of any blocked alternative with that same disposition.
[payment batches] Every line is screened ON ITS OWN against the transfer lines above — the batch total is not screened and does not affect any line. Each line receives its own action and reason code.
